scripts.title: Universal RTX and SSR Shaders
scripts.features: An optimized and stable environmental reflection & lighting shader designed for Roblox. Bypasses the 31 highlight rendering limit by using a localized 55-stud proximity wrap and features automatic ground tracking. Highly stable, with zero player character cloning to ensure no hitbox or limb glitches. Includes 4 beautifully calibrated sky presets (Sunset, Day, Space, Cyberpunk) with forced-frame lighting updates to prevent day/night cycle overrides.

comments.text:
Thank you all so much for 600+ views in such a short time! 🚀
I wanted to make this script 100% Open Source so that the community can use, modify, and learn from it. Unlike many obfuscated scripts, this code is completely clean and readable. You can check the source code on my Pastebin anytime!
Quick Tips:
If the in-game day/night script tries to reset the time, my script will override it every frame to keep your selected atmosphere active.
It is highly optimized to bypass the Roblox 31-highlight limit by dynamically rendering reflections on objects within a 55-stud radius around you.
Feel free to share your thoughts, screenshots, or any feature requests in the comments. Enjoy the RTX looks! 🌟
